name: PunisherWatchlist
description: Adds eye buttons to movies, series, and episodes plus a personal Watchlist tab on the Jellyfin home screen.

versions.changelog: Fixes the standalone Watchlist initially showing every media item. A dedicated provider state now constrains all native list requests to saved Watchlist IDs independently of route timing, with controlled native-list refreshes after navigation to replace any early unfiltered request.
